children: The USDA has announced new flash sales of grain exports to start the week. In its latest notice, the USDA says that 114,000 metric tons of soybeans were sold for delivery to China in the 2026/27 marketing year. An additional 261,000 tons of soybeans were listed as sold to unknown destinations for 2026/27 delivery. 'Unknown destinations' is often another moniker for sales to China, although not necessarily the case. The notice continues a streak of sales announcements to China that began last week. Early in trading, CBOT soybean futures slide 0.3%, while corn is down 0.4% and wheat falls 0.1%. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
